'''2001 Denver World Qualifier''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG World Championship qualifier in Denver, Colorado, in 2001. [[Brian Hunter]] swept it.<ref name="dt-17600">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17600 HB Flip done RIGHT aka I am Sick of Hunt Down], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 17 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17600/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17600/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 30 June 2001<ref name="tr-d2571" />
* '''Site:''' Denver, Colorado; Collectormania, Parker, Colorado<ref name="tr-d2571" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
* '''Players:''' 39<ref name="tr-d2663" />

The event is known from Brian Hunter's DeckTech posts of 17 July 2001; they give no exact date. It was played before [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] was tournament legal. It is a different event from the [[2001 Denver DPC]] of 1 September 2001.

Hunter posted his Light deck as the one "that swept the Denver World Championship Qualifier".<ref name="dt-17600" /> He described his Dark [[Brian Hunter MKOS done RIGHT aka How to Qualify for Worlds|My Kind Of Scum]] deck, posted the same day under the title "How to Qualify for Worlds", as undefeated and as having won tournaments "before, during, and after the Denver World Qualifier Weekend".<ref name="dt-17604">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17604 MKOS done RIGHT aka How to Qualify for Worlds], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 17 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17604/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17604/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
